200.description:
Records (records/list) of the last PSC snapshot part only, which carries PSC statements, exemptions and late filings: paged JSON-lines records with the totals line skipped. Each page re-downloads the part (about 5 MB) and checks its ETag against the cursor; a cursor issued for an earlier publication fails with invalid_input at /cursor, issue code publication_changed. PSC records follow persons_with_significant_control (name, kind, notified_on, ceased_on, registration_number, nature_of_control with a derived percentage band); dates of birth keep month and year only, and usual residential addresses and identity verification details are never returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
PSC bulk snapshot version check (source/status) from download.companieshouse.gov.uk/en_pscdata.html: the snapshot date, the single-file snapshot and the N numbered parts with Content-Length, ETag and Last-Modified (HEAD), and the register totals (persons_of_significant_control_count, statements_count, exemptions_count, generated_at) read from the last line of the last part, which is downloaded and inflated. Parts 1 to N-1 (31 to 80 MB compressed, hundreds of MB inflated) and the 2.5 GB single file are beyond what one call may fetch and hold, so their URLs and validators are the hand-off; they are never downloaded. publication_id is <snapshot_date>:<last part ETag>.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `full_snapshot` | object | The single-file snapshot (about 2.5 GB): a hand-off, never downloaded here. |
| `generated_at` | string | Copy of totals.generated_at. |
| `latest_part` | object | The last part, downloaded and inflated in this call to read the totals record. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page_last_updated` | string | The page's 'Last Updated' text (UK local time, DD/MM/YYYY HH:MMhrs). |
| `part_count` | number | N, the number of numbered parts. |
| `parts` | object[] | Parts 1..N in order. Parts 1..N-1 are hand-offs validated with HEAD and never downloaded (31 to 80 MB compressed, hundreds of MB inflated); part N is downloaded in this call. |
| `publication_id` | string | <snapshot_date>:<last part ETag>; psc_latest_part cursors pin this value. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | RFC 3339 UTC time of the fetch. |
| `snapshot_date` | string | Snapshot date named in the file names. |
| `source_url` | string | The download page that lists the snapshot files. |
| `totals` | object | Register totals from the last line of the last part. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
